subject: Co-sell listing: minimal security artifacts required for multi-cloud marketplaces
messages:
From: AWS Marketplace Onboarding <marketplace-onboarding@amazonaws.com>
To: evelyn.hart@redwood.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 22 Nov 2026 11:12:00 -0500
Subject: Marketplace co-sell review — minimum artifacts request

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks for initiating the marketplace listing for Redwood. For co-sell eligibility across AWS/GCP/Azure we need a compact package of security artifacts so partner review can proceed. For our initial pass please provide the following: 

- SOC 2 Type II (summary report or SOC 2 letter)
- Recent third-party penetration test or an executive attestation letter if full report is restricted
- Executed DPA or redline excerpt showing data handling/retention terms (Annex A recommended)
- Contact for security/infosec reviewer

If you can drop a single zip or a Drive folder link by EOD Monday we can queue the triage team. If anything on that list is restricted, a one-page attestation describing where the artifact lives and who can access it will suffice for the co-sell intake.

Regards,
Jane Holloway
AWS Marketplace Onboarding
[Attachment: onboarding-checklist-v3.pdf (PDF)]
From: evelyn.hart@redwood.com
To: marketplace-onboarding@amazonaws.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 22 Nov 2026 12:05:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace co-sell review — minimum artifacts request

Jane —

Thanks for the clear list. We're assembling a compact evidence bundle for AWS and will mirror it to the GCP/Azure intake teams. Quick notes:  

- SOC 2 Type II: we can provide a redacted summary PDF and a contact for auditor verification.
- Pen test: full report is sensitive; we have a signed attestation letter from our pentest vendor and an internal remediation digest.
- DPA: the executed DPA is under NDA for some customers; I can provide the DPA Annex A excerpt and a pointer to the legal sign-off record.

Plan: I will share a Drive folder with the redacted SOC2, the pen-test attestation, DPA excerpt, and an index CSV that maps artifacts to the marketplace requirements. Attaching the index CSV and SOC2 summary now. Sergio (cc'ed) will confirm the attestation wording.

Deliverables (expected by 16:30 ET):  
- Drive link to evidence folder
- marketplace-evidence-index.csv (attached)
- PenTest attestation PDF (attached)

Evelyn Hart
Senior Partner Ops Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SOC2_Type2_summary_2025.pdf (PDF)]
[Attachment: marketplace-evidence-index.csv (CSV)]
From: evelyn.hart@redwood.com
To: sergio.alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 22 Nov 2026 13:00:00 -05:00
Subject: Fwd: Marketplace co-sell review — need pen-test attestation wording

Sergio — forwarding the intake from AWS. They will accept an attestation letter from our vendor instead of the full pentest report. Can you: 

1) Confirm the attestation language is sufficient for marketplace triage (I drafted one-line language below).
2) If needed, add a short remediation summary (one paragraph) describing open items and expected close dates.

Draft attestation language: "Redwood Inference engaged SecureProbe Labs to conduct a penetration test against our inference platform in August 2026. SecureProbe Labs confirms they performed the assessment, identified issues, and Redwood implemented mitigations. Full report contains sensitive findings and will be shared under NDAs with marketplace security reviewers upon request."

Let me know edits ASAP — I want to include the final attestation in the folder we share with AWS/GCP/Azure.

Thanks,
Evelyn

> On Mon, Nov 22, 2026 at 11:12 AM AWS Marketplace Onboarding <marketplace-onboarding@amazonaws.com> wrote:
> > Hi Evelyn,
> > 
> > For co-sell eligibility across AWS/GCP/Azure we need a compact package of security artifacts so partner review can proceed...
From: evelyn.hart@redwood.com
To: marketplace-onboarding@amazonaws.com
Cc: gcp-partner-ops@google.com, azure-marketplace@microsoft.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com, sergio.alvarez@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 22 Nov 2026 16:30:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace co-sell review — minimal artifacts bundle (Drive link + index)

Hi Jane / GCP / Azure teams —

Per your request, we uploaded a compact evidence bundle for initial co-sell triage. Folder contains redacted artifacts plus an access plan for reviewers:

- SOC2_Type2_summary_2025.pdf (redacted summary)
- PenTest_Attestation_Redwood_2026.pdf (vendor attestation)
- DPA_AnnexA_excerpt.docx (executed language excerpt)
- marketplace-evidence-index.csv (artifact mapping + contact points)

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cMarketEvidence
JIRA intake: INF-4821 (internal tracker for marketplace onboarding)
DocuSign (executed DPA record): https://www.docusign.com/en-US/Acme-RW-Marketplace-Agreement

Notes on access: the full pentest report is restricted; per our standard process we will grant NDA-backed access to security teams and provide a short remediation summary in the folder. Contact for technical reviewer: sergio.alvarez@redwood.com. Legal contact for DPA questions: laura.bennett@redwood.com.

If you need additional artifacts (vulnerability management policy, penetration testing cadence, or encryption key lifecycle details) tell us which specific checks you want and we'll append them to the same folder.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Partner Ops Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: PenTest_Attestation_Redwood_2026.pdf (PDF)]
